component.name: FujiNet Go Apple II
component.summary: Self-contained Apple II with built-in FujiNet

description.p: An Apple II with FujiNet built in: mount disk images from TNFS servers or the local SD folder, configure everything through the embedded FujiNet web UI, and play with automatic gamepad support driving the analog paddles.

Emulation is provided by AppleWin, with FujiNet attached as a SmartPort card in slot 7 -- the slot the Apple //e autostart ROM scans before the Disk ][, so the machine boots straight into FujiNet's CONFIG.

screenshot.caption: FujiNet CONFIG running on the emulated Apple II

description.p: First release of the Apple II desktop app: AppleWin's libretro core driven on a vsync-phase-locked emulator thread, with the FujiNet firmware built in-process and joined over SmartPort-over-SLIP.
